title: Axolotof Advancements
description: A little more advancements to spice up your day!
body:
# Advancements! This mod is set to bring you all the advancements you could ask for!
![Axolotof Advancements Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b38cb1e5b373843d0c975c409e59310bbd17dcfe_0.webp) ## New Advancements! What new advancements are in store for us today? ### Building As the oppsite of mining, this tab lets you explore the wonders of building. I made this tab to let you see what blocks can be used, what tricks can be seen, and what blocks are cool. ### Villagers This tab has everything relating to Villagers - trading, raiding, Trial Chambers, and Mansions! All of it in put together here. ### Redstone The Redstone tab is the smallest, but one of the more diverse tabs. Anything and everything technical and redstone-y goes here. ### Other Tab Revamps All other tabs have been tweaked a tad or had their stuff moved around. There's new stuff there, too! **_Enjoy :D_**
